description:
Ten years of block prints, tote bags and tea towels. Now the work has a name.

Introducing NAV — the product brand of Nav Prabhuthi Trust. 🌱

NAV is an initiative of Nav Prabhuthi Trust, bringing together handcrafted products created by autistic adults as part of their vocational training. Block printing, tailoring, textiles, paper craft — real trades, learned properly, held to a standard.

On Thursday 6 August, we’re unveiling the Handcrafted Products Collection 2026 at Sabha Blr. You’re invited.

name: Peptides and Petals
description:
Peptides & Petals is an intimate afternoon hosted by Maya Medi Spa—a US-founded medical aesthetics clinic, now bringing internationally acclaimed skincare treatments and products to Bangalore and Hyderabad.

Discover the science of regenerative skincare as we explore the power of peptides and their role in healthy, radiant skin. Thoughtfully curated around wellness and timeless beauty, expect expert insights, meaningful conversations, beautiful moments, and a few delightful surprises along the way.

name: Let's Be Honest: Serious Slice Comes to Indiranagar
description:
Let's be honest.

Bangalore has plenty of pizza. What it needs is pizza worth coming back for.

That's what we've built Serious Slice around—72-hour fermented sourdough, San Marzano pomodoro, a Neapolitan bake we refuse to rush, and a menu where the dough always takes centre stage.

Indiranagar is next.

Before we open to the public, we're hosting an exclusive pre-opening lunch.

A handful of seats. The first pizzas from our new oven. A limited menu, an intimate setting, and the chance to experience Serious Slice before everyone else.

Honest pizza. Made properly. Served first, to a very short list.

name: Everything you know about Beer, plus one thing you don’t.
description:
A Biergarten Experience | Vol. 4

Beer deserves better than "I'll have the usual."

Spend an afternoon understanding what you're actually drinking - from styles and brewing techniques to hops, malt, IBU, and the subtle differences that make every pint unique.

This isn't a beer festival. It's a masterclass disguised as a great afternoon.

And just when you think you've tasted it all, we'll pour something unexpected.

Introducing Orange Spritz - our very first cider. Bright, refreshing, citrus-forward, and available to this table before anyone else.

Limited seats, so get yours now!

name: Versus Experience - Marvel Tokon Edition
description:
FAQs

What is a Marvel Tokon Launch Party?
A community event with Marvel Tokon, casual play, tournaments, music, food, and drinks.

Do I need a controller?
No - PS5 controllers are provided, or bring your own compatible controller.

Can I join the tournament?
Yes! Register online. On-site registration is subject to availability.

Will there be other games?
Yes - Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Pokémon Champions and Avatar Legends.

Are there prizes?
Yes! The Top 6 Marvel Tokon players win a free game copy, plus a ₹45,000 prize pool across the other tournaments.

Do I need to own the game?
No. Game stations will be available for everyone.

Will there be music?
Yes! Live DJ sets all day featuring Robu, Insowmya, Vidur Grover, and Red$uzuki95.

Will there be food & drinks?
Yes. Food, beer, gin, vodka, and whisky will be available for purchase.

Is this a 21+ event?
No. Alcohol is served only to guests of legal drinking age with valid government-issued ID.
